name: Buying Friendship: Gelkis

faq.answer: You carry the tote of totems to the quartermaster inside Gelkis Village. Even among primitive centaur, a clan treasurer manages such offerings.
faq.q: Who receives the totems in Gelkis Village?

faq.answer: Scouts report far fewer Gelkis than Magram roaming across the wastes. Yet despite smaller numbers, the clan endures as one of the dominant centaur forces in Desolace.
faq.q: How do the Gelkis compare to the Magram clan?

faq.answer: Delivering the tote of totems earns goodwill with the Gelkis clan. Offering valuable totems helps secure peace with their chieftains.
faq.q: Why deliver a tote of totems to the Gelkis?

faq.answer: Gelkis Village lies far to the southwest within the wastes of Desolace.
The clan will not deal with sworn enemies. You need at least neutral standing with the Gelkis centaur before approaching their village with the offering.
faq.q: Who can offer the totems to the Gelkis?

sections.body: The Gelkis clan holds ground far to the southwest in Desolace, despite being outnumbered by their Magram rivals. Scouts hear little from their camps, yet the centaur endure as a dominant force in the dry wastes. Carrying a tote of totems to the quartermaster in Gelkis Village offers a direct path to win their favor. The clan demands at least neutral standing before accepting any peaceful overture.
sections.title: Offerings in the Southwest

summary: Securing peace with the Gelkis centaur requires proving your goodwill with valuable offerings. You carry a tote of totems to Gelkis Village far to the southwest in Desolace, seeking their quartermaster to cement an alliance.
attribution: In-game quest text: Buying Friendship: Gelkis
